header_text: Congratulations! You’ve been granted the Data Access Request Reviewer permissions for [[TEAM_NAME]].
subject: [[ASSIGNER_NAME]] has added you to the [[TEAM_NAME]] publishing team on the Gateway as a Reviewer
body:
Dear [[USER_FIRSTNAME]], [[ASSIGNER_NAME]] has granted you Data Access Request (DAR) Reviewer permissions for [[TEAM_NAME]] on the Gateway. You can now:
  • Review sections of a data access request assigned to you for [[TEAM_NAME]]
